ENABLED_SUBTITLE: Keeps images and videos from loading over a cellular or metered connection.
ALLOW_METERED_SUBTITLE: Overrides the choices below and loads everything anyway.
IMAGES_SUBTITLE: Skip ordinary image attachments on mobile data.
GIFS_SUBTITLE: Skip animated GIFs on mobile data.
VIDEOS_SUBTITLE: Skip video attachments on mobile data.
EMOJIS_SUBTITLE: Skip custom emojis on mobile data.
